values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground bordered on the east by the Little Manistee River (the river runs along sites 21-26); a mix of heavily wooded and open-field sites. Popular with ORV users: the Little Manistee Trail leaves directly from the campground. Trout and steelhead fishing. Lake County, 2.8 mi east of Luther via E Old M 63 and N Kings Hwy; managed by the DNR Baldwin Field Office. --Claude
